purpose: Evidence behind fictional service-delivery puzzles. Research findings describe their study populations; the game does not estimate local causal effects of AI.
scope_rules: Show the original study place, dates and sample alongside every research claim.
District or state statistics describe that administrative area, never the exact selected street, village or household.
A source from another place can motivate a mechanism, but cannot establish the selected place's current bottleneck.
Cases, scene details, counts, deadlines, AI capabilities and game outcomes are invented simulations, not reported interviews or forecasts.
None of these studies establishes the effectiveness of the game's AI stacks.
Do not rank local priorities causally from prevalence alone; higher prevalence is a prompt for investigation, not proof of the best intervention.

sources.title: Improving Governance Through Biometric Authentication and Secure Payments in India
sources.publisher: J-PAL; research by Karthik Muralidharan, Paul Niehaus and Sandip Sukhtankar
sources.location: Eight districts in undivided Andhra Pradesh, India
sources.claim: A reform combining biometric cards with village payment providers improved payment delivery despite incomplete adoption. Beneficiaries collected employment payments faster; improvements also reached people without cards, suggesting payment organization mattered alongside technology.
sources.scope: A bundled payment-system reform, not a trial of document AI or a finding that biometric requirements always help.
sources.game_inference: Separate a prepared claim from money actually received. A document assistant can organize evidence; a payment hold still needs a real administrative handoff.

sources.title: Improving Immunization Rates Through Regular Camps and Incentives in India
sources.publisher: J-PAL; research by Abhijit Banerjee, Esther Duflo, Rachel Glennerster and Dhruva Kothari
sources.claim: Regular immunization camps increased full immunization. Adding small non-cash incentives increased it further and improved cost effectiveness through greater use of the camps.
sources.scope: Historical randomized study in the sampled rural villages; not a measurement of present-day Udaipur or a trial of AI reminders.
sources.game_inference: A reminder helps a family reach an available appointment; it cannot make an absent team appear. Announce clinic capacity before the player spends scarce effort.

sources.title: Using Learning Camps to Improve Basic Learning Outcomes of Primary School Children in India
sources.publisher: J-PAL; Pratham and Government of Uttar Pradesh evaluation
sources.location: Sitapur and Unnao districts, Uttar Pradesh, India
sources.sample: 17,266 students; schools randomized across four groups
sources.claim: Pratham-led camps grouped children by assessed learning level and improved reading and mathematics. Providing learning materials alone had no measured language benefit and only a small mathematics effect.
sources.scope: A supported teaching intervention in sampled schools. It does not show that AI-generated worksheets alone cause learning gains.
sources.game_inference: Let the player discover that a fluent worksheet can miss a child's current reading level. Assessment and protected instructor time are separate requirements.

sources.title: Hiring Additional Instructors in Childcare Centers in India Improved Learning and Nutrition
sources.publisher: J-PAL; research by Alejandro Ganimian, Karthik Muralidharan and Christopher Walters
sources.location: Four districts in Tamil Nadu, India
sources.claim: Adding an education-focused worker increased instructional time and improved learning. The main worker could spend more time on health and nutrition; the study also found reductions in stunting and severe malnutrition.
sources.scope: Evidence for additional human staffing in this programme, not evidence that software substitutes for staff or that nutrition changes within a game's short run.
sources.game_inference: One worker cannot attend two places simultaneously. Score completed support visits rather than instant nutritional recovery; scheduling tools can conserve capacity but not create unlimited care.

sources.title: Improving Immunization Coverage Through Incentives, Reminders, and Social Networks in India
sources.claim: Researchers compared reminders, community-nominated immunization ambassadors and incentive designs. The strongest tested combination paired ambassadors, increasing incentives and reminders; reminders with ambassadors were also economical relative to the existing programme.
sources.scope: A comparison of specified intervention packages, not proof that more messages always help or that an AI voice creates trust.
sources.game_inference: Distinguish contact from successful attendance. A trusted local handoff can unlock a case that a repeated automated message cannot.

sources.title: Promoting latrine construction and use in rural villages practicing open defecation: process evaluation in connection with a randomised controlled trial in Orissa, India
sources.publisher: Boisson and colleagues; BMC Research Notes, 2014
sources.sample: Process evaluation within a 100-village trial; repeated construction observations in 50 intervention villages
sources.claim: Researchers observed construction progress, interviewed implementation teams and surveyed households to examine how the sanitation programme was actually delivered. The intervention combined construction support and community mobilisation.
sources.scope: Implementation research on the historical programme. A recorded facility or information campaign alone does not establish actual service availability or use at a selected place.
sources.game_inference: A photo or report can flag a blocked service; a repair still needs a worker and materials. End the case on verified working access rather than the number of reports filed.

sources.title: National Family Health Survey-5: India Districts Factsheet Data (Provisional)
sources.publisher: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / International Institute for Population Sciences; data.gov.in
sources.location: India; district estimates for many indicators
sources.sample: NFHS-5 district factsheets; denominator and precision differ by indicator
sources.claim: The official catalogue provides district estimates for many population, health and nutrition indicators. Parenthesized percentages use 25-49 unweighted cases; an asterisk suppresses estimates based on fewer than 25 cases.
sources.scope: Historical survey estimates, not current village observations, a diagnosis of causes, or a ranking of problems by AI suitability. Preserve missing values and small-sample flags.
sources.game_inference: Use a clearly dated district fact to open a local scenario, then explicitly label its household story and operational obstacles as fictional.

sources.title: Into the Breach
sources.claim: The game's turn-based combat shows impending attacks in advance so the player can choose a counter.
sources.game_inference: Borrow advance warning and small consequential turns: show what tomorrow's closure or capacity cut will strand, then let the player save one route.

fictional_scene_notes: A passbook stays inside a folded plastic bag. The bus fare has already been spent once. Today the missing reference number is on your screen.
The message reached the phone. It did not reach the grandmother carrying it. The visiting worker has one stop left before the bus returns.
The worksheet is full of paragraphs. The child is still sounding out single words. The teacher turns the sheet over and starts again.
The repair request has a photograph and a tracking number. At the tap there is still a queue of empty pots. The mechanic is waiting for the part.
These are original fictional scenes. They are not quotations, reporting, portraits of actual residents or imitations of a particular writer.

implemented_loop.name: Fieldwork
implemented_loop.duration: Seven short shifts; target eight of twelve cases reaching a service
implemented_loop.setup: Choose a place, one narrowly defined service segment, and one of two AI kits with a clearly different strength and weakness.
implemented_loop.turn: Three queues are visible: explanations, records and field visits. Press A for the AI desk, B for the worker, or R to move the AI once. Exact outcome previews and a next-shift forecast support planning.
implemented_loop.progress: Show waiting -> ready -> reached, with a concrete cause for every stalled or completed case.
implemented_loop.tension: Batch cheap preparation today or spend the scarce human visit to complete an urgent case before tomorrow's closure. Neither the flashiest AI nor always taking the nearest deadline should dominate.
implemented_loop.information: Hide future cases, never hide the immediate price of the action. Reveal a future constraint early enough to respond.
implemented_loop.ending: One short before/after scene and the number of completed handoffs; distinguish service completion from poverty, disease or learning outcomes. Offer the same seed with the other kit.
